ns2:section.sectionText: This section is restricted to online programs only. There will be field visits/laboratory sessions on two Saturdays (September10, 2022 and September 17, 2022). These sessions are mandatory for on-campus students (ONL) and optional for off-campus students (OLP). Students are required to log in and use canvas in order to complete this course. .
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
